extraction.name: C-E VAL
extraction.description: A multi-level multi-discipline Chinese evaluation suite for foundation models comprising 13,948 multiple-choice exam questions across 52 diverse disciplines and four difficulty levels: middle school, high school, college, and professional. It is designed to assess advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context, and is accompanied by C-E VAL HARD, a subset of particularly challenging subjects.
extraction.creator: Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Junteng Liu, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, Junxian He
extraction.citeAs: Huang, Y., Bai, Y., Zhu, Z., Zhang, J., Zhang, J., Su, T., Liu, J., Lv, C., Zhang, Y., Lei, J., Fu, Y., Sun, M., He, J. C-E VAL: A Multi-Level Multi-Discipline Chinese Evaluation Suite for Foundation Models. NeurIPS 2023 Track on Datasets and Benchmarks. arXiv:2305.08322.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: C-E VAL was constructed from real-world, challenging human exams in China. The benchmark covers four difficulty levels: middle school, high school, college, and professional. The primary source of the data is mock exams freely available on the internet. In addition, a portion of the college-level questions are past exam questions from top universities in China publicly shared by students, and around 2000 college questions are mock questions for the national graduate entrance exam sourced from the Weipu website with authorization. To mitigate data contamination, the authors collect data either from mock exams or from small-scale local exams rather than exact questions from official national exams.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Document analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The collected data come in various formats, primarily as PDF or Microsoft Word documents and a minor fraction as web pages. Most samples are sourced from PDF or Microsoft Word documents on the internet rather than directly from plain text or structured questions.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: All questions in C-E VAL are processed to include exactly four choices. Most original questions already had four choices; questions with fewer than four options were eliminated, and for questions with more than four options, incorrect choices were randomly dropped. Questions were randomly split within each subject into development, validation, and test sets. The development split per subject consists of five exemplars, and the validation and test set are created with a 1:9 ratio.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: PDF documents are initially processed into text. All questions are subsequently parsed, automatically when possible and otherwise manually by the authors, into a structured format. For subjects with complex mathematical notations, the authors manually convert them into standard LaTeX formats. All questions go through standard preprocessing such as deduplication and cleaning. The questions then undergo several rounds of human validation by the authors, and all LaTeX notations are ensured to compile without syntax errors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The documents are carefully annotated by the authors to obtain the final structured format. The questions undergo several rounds of human validation by the authors. For the development split, explanation data for few-shot chain-of-thought is produced by first prompting GPT-4 to generate step-by-step explanations for the ground-truth answer, then manually revising the generated explanations to obtain the final explanations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The generated explanations for the development split are further revised manually to obtain the final explanations. The questions also undergo several rounds of human validation by the authors.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Ground-truth labels of the development and validation splits are released, while labels of the test split are kept private. Users are required to submit model predictions to https://cevalbenchmark.com to automatically obtain test accuracy, where a public leaderboard is maintained. Users can choose whether to include their submission results in the live leaderboard.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors anticipate C-E VAL will help analyze important strengths and shortcomings of foundation models, foster their development and growth for Chinese users, guide developers to understand model abilities from multiple dimensions, and facilitate the growth of foundation models for Chinese users.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The paper notes that English benchmarks tend to exhibit geographical biases towards the domestic knowledge of the regions that produce them. C-E VAL is motivated by the need to evaluate models in a Chinese context, including knowledge of Chinese culture, history, laws, and competencies unique to Chinese society. The paper also discusses option bias and reports that fluctuations in the proportion of correct options are relatively small around a random 25% level and similar to MMLU.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The authors note that C-E VAL, along with English-language benchmarks, is far from perfect for LLM evaluation. There are many other abilities such as reasoning over and calling APIs, as well as aspects beyond accuracy including safety, bias, and robustness, which are not covered. The validation split has only 1346 questions total, with each subject contributing fewer than 30 validation questions on average, so tracking accuracy on a specific subject may not yield significant insights.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context. It can be used as a whole benchmark suite or subsets can be separately utilized to assess certain model abilities of interest and analyze strengths and limitations of foundation models. The development split facilitates few-shot evaluation and few-shot chain-of-thought settings, the validation set is intended for hyperparameter tuning, and the test set is used for benchmark evaluation through submission to the official website.
